bars.size_max_why: As round 1: 1,000 simulated tests per cell, Monte Carlo standard error 0.69 points at 5%; 6.5% is about 2.2 standard errors above.
bars.size_max_rule: For a cell of n tests the bar is 0.05 + 2.2 * sqrt(0.05 * 0.95 / n), rounded to three decimals: 0.065 at n = 1,000, 0.074 at n = 400.

deviations.what: The power run stopped before computing anything: the covariance of the 42 industry series (12- and 30-industry portfolios) is singular, because four 30-industry portfolios (Hlth, Util, Telcm, Fin) are identical in every month to their 12-industry counterparts (Hlth, Utils, Telcm, Money), so its Cholesky factor does not exist.
deviations.change: The real-shaped generator draws only the distinct series and copies each identical series from its twin, as in the real data (sim2.mjs shapeParams and simulateShaped). Nothing else changed; the power run was repeated with the registered seeds. Calibration and real-data results were already complete and do not use this code.
deviations.effect: Industry momentum's real-shaped panels keep the four identical pairs identical; without the fix the industry-momentum power cells could not be run.
